description: Search the NeoSatoshi card catalog. Results are full card objects like a detection returns (set, number, rarity, Cardmarket product ID, daily prices, images), at most 10, with has_more but no total. Use it first to fix a wrong detection: pass request_id and card_index from recognize_cards. That correction search is free (5 searches per detected card within 24 hours, at most 5 results), then call correct_card. Without request_id it is the paid card search: 0.5 credits when it returns a card, nothing for no result. Query: q (a card name, at least 3 letters, optionally with the number like "charizard 4/102", or a printed code like OP01-003; Digimon: a card number alone like BT1-025 works), or set + number. Wildcards and set-only or number-only queries are refused. Football (tcg "football"): q only, the player with optional set or season words ("kane chrome 2023"), no language, set or number, no prices yet; each result carries a ref for get_card. Football detections cannot be corrected yet.

card_index.description: cards[].card_index of the card to correct (with request_id).

language.description: Card language, e.g. en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, zh (per game; Digimon en or ja). Default: the detected card's language, else en. Leave it out for football.

number.description: Card number, together with set (or q).

q.description: Card name (at least 3 letters), optionally with the number, or a printed code (Digimon: a card number like BT1-025). Football: the player, optionally with set or season words.

request_id.description: request_id of a detection: makes this a free correction search.

set.description: Set id or code, together with number (Digimon: the set code, e.g. BT1 with number 025).

tcg.description: Game. Required without request_id; default with it: the detected card's game.

name: search_cards
title: Search the card catalog
